During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Cipher Nine]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] embarked on a '''campaign''' to track down and eliminate the [[Star Cabal]], a shadowy conspiracy that was manipulating the war in order to destroy both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
